GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

5. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

9. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

10. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

11. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

12. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
